{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Initial reports from the team indicated the climate had changed from that seen by the Imperial surveyors. The students arrived during the stormy season there. It's pretty severe.''"<br />"''Bad weather doesn't sound that dangerous.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]]|<ref name="Onslaught">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide I: Onslaught]]''</ref>}}
The '''storm season''' was a [[season/Legends|season]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Bimmiel/Legends|Bimmiel]],<ref name="Onslaught" /> [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]],<ref name="Goroth">''[[Goroth: Slave of the Empire]]''</ref> [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]],<ref name="TVD">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> [[Kintan/Legends|Kintan]],<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]],<ref name="TISWU">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> and [[Vortex/Legends|Vortex]].<ref name="DA">[[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']]</ref>

[[File:Kamino_Tipoca_City.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Kamino during its storm season]]
The [[Waterworld/Legends|waterworld]] Kamino had long storm seasons<ref name="TVD" /> that the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]] called the [[Beautiful Season]].<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|31|KAM 1-4|Kamino}}</ref>

The [[Desert/Legends|desert]] planet Tatooine had an [[Local year|annual]] [[sandstorm season]]. The [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] held a [[swap meet]] in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]], the [[Great Swap Meet]], just before the start of the storm season.<ref name="TISWU" />
